albums.title: Mission Files
albums.about: Eight original instrumental spy tracks, made at HQ.

albums.title: Singles & Intros
albums.about: Stream intros, theme songs, and anthems from HQ.

songs.title: Operation Countdown
songs.about: The opening briefing. Staccato strings, brass stabs, and a clock that will not stop.

songs.title: Operation Fuse
songs.about: The fuse is lit. Brass and a bass line that will not sit still.

songs.title: Operation Riptide
songs.about: Surf guitar on the night shift. Twang, reverb, and full speed.

songs.title: Operation Undertow
songs.about: The surf rock file, pulled deeper. Tremolo guitar and big brass.

songs.title: Operation Night Watch
songs.about: A lo-fi stakeout. Muted trumpet, soft rain, and a long night.

songs.title: Operation Cold Coffee
songs.about: Still on the stakeout. Quiet piano and a coffee gone cold.

songs.title: Operation Slapback
songs.about: Slap bass and electronic drums. The chase is on.

songs.title: Operation Drop Zone
songs.about: Risers, then the drop. Full brass and bass to close the file.

songs.title: Wiretap
songs.about: The newest HQ intro. Part of the broadcast rotation.
